title: What you pay against what you get
label: One large hanging pan balance. A single weight for the price lands on the left pan: the Team plan, 12 months at $300, $3,600 a year, and the beam tips toward price. Three value weights then drop onto the right pan one by one, each sized by its yearly amount: tools replaced (3 tools at $720, $2,160), onboarding days saved (12 days at $300, $3,600) and hours saved (240 hours at $40, $9,600). The second weight carries the value past the price and the beam swings over to value; the third presses it down to its stop. The return multiple on the left steps up as each weight lands, 0.6x, 1.6x, then 4.3x: $15,360 of value for $3,600 paid.
heading:
Put the price
on the scale.
sub: Then add a year of what it saves, each weight priced at your own rates. The beam settles where the sums put it.
ratioLabel: the price, paid back in a year
